title: Utilizing Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy to Understand the Resistance of β-Ga2O3 Under High Electron Radiation From the STEM Probe.
content: Interest in ultrawide bandgap (UWBG) semiconductors for space and nuclear applications have been growing, with beta gallium oxide (β-Ga2O3) being a prime candidate due to the robust nature of the material in harsh environments such as high temperature and radiation [1]. β-Ga2O3 has favorable properties such as a UWBG of ∼4.8 eV [2] and tunable n-type doping, [3] however, to enable the use of β-Ga2O3 based devices for space and nuclear applications, the effects of radiation damage for β-Ga2O3 need to be further investigated.
